_meta.purpose: TEMPLATE. Your pharmacogenetic genotypes (from a laboratory report and/or a full VCF). PERSONAL — do not pass it on.
_meta.how_to_fill: With a full VCF most loci resolve automatically (see the genome/ folder). Single genotypes from a PDF report can be entered into genotypes[]. An empty list is a legitimate state — it means «not read», not «normal».
_meta.shape: genotypes: [{ gene, rsid, genotype, interpretation?, drug? }]
